<h3>Germany & Europe Climate–Sentiment</h3>
<p>Reproducible R + Python pipeline for the STAR Protocols paper: tweet preprocessing, LIWC22 sentiment analysis, climate-variable extraction to NUTS regions, and spatiotemporal INLA (BYM/BYM2, fused-lasso temporal effects). Backs both iScience papers on Germany and Europe.</p>
